add_document_demo.question: How do I sign up for the transit subsidy, and which organization code do I enter?
add_document_demo.before:
To sign up for the transit subsidy, please see the transit benefit page [Benefits › Transit subsidies].

The handbook does not provide specific instructions for signing up or the organization code to enter for the transit subsidy. Please contact People Ops (TTS-PeopleOps@gsa.gov) for assistance with this process.

*This handbook is a snapshot from June 2026; please confirm with HR.*
add_document_demo.after:
To sign up for the transit subsidy, go to https://transitapp.ost.dot.gov/, click **Register**, update your password, log in with your government email, review the "Rules of behavior," click **I Agree**, click **Transit Benefit Application**, select "Certify/Enroll," and click **Continue** [Transit Benefit › Enrolling in transit benefit].

Regarding the organization codes:
*   Use **T-TECH TRANSFORMATION SERVICE** as your organizational code [Transit Benefit › Enrolling in transit benefit].
*   Within the "Transit Benefit Program Application" section of the form, enter **Q - Federal Acquisition Service** for the "Organization Code" field [Transit Benefit › Enrolling in transit benefit].

*This handbook is a snapshot from June 2026; please confirm with HR.*
